meta.title: 普通场控vs牛批场控
meta.topic: 直播带货 · 场控对比

scenes.context: 普通场控：这件衣服是不是很好看？好看。非常好看对不对？是吗？有没有想要的？想要打个想要。所有人把身高体重打成公屏，后台统计身高体重。这是错误示范，这叫接话。语域：直播教学，反例演示。
sentences: 这件衣服是不是很好看？好看。
Isn't this top gorgeous? Yes, gorgeous.
isn't this gorgeous（是不是很好看）
想要的话，打个想要。
If you want it, type 'want it'.
type want it（打「想要」）
这叫接话，是错误示范。
That's just echoing — the wrong example.
just echoing（接话）
paraphrase: 接话 → echo / just repeat back
错误示范 → the wrong example / a bad demo
scenes.speak: Isn't this top gorgeous? Yes, gorgeous. If you want it, type 'want it'. That's just echoing — the wrong example.

scenes.title_en: The Right Way: Catch the Emotion
scenes.context: 厉害的场控要接情绪。这件好看吗？太好看了。这件好看吗？好好看啊九哥。你好适合这件啊。你上次回头率都高，穿这件。谁说不好看，我跟他急。语域：直播教学，正例示范。
sentences: 厉害的场控，接的是情绪。
Elite stage control catches the emotion.
catches the emotion（接情绪）
这件好看吗？好好看啊！
Is this pretty? So pretty!
so pretty（好好看）
谁说不好看，我跟他急。
Say it's not pretty and I'll fight you.
I'll fight you（我跟他急）
paraphrase: 接情绪 → catch the emotion / tune into the mood
跟他急 → fight you / take it personally
scenes.speak: Elite stage control catches the emotion. Is this pretty? So pretty! Say it's not pretty and I'll fight you.

scenes.context: 今天是显灰吗？怎么可能。显白，显白两度。这个叫安哥拉红的颜色，高级。牛血色、猪肝色是不是一种口红？涂完之后整个脸是不是亮了？10米开外感受到你的气场。语域：直播教学，情绪放大。
sentences: 显白两度，这个叫安哥拉红。
Two shades brighter — this is Angola red.
two shades brighter（显白两度）
涂完之后，整个脸都亮了。
After applying, the whole face lights up.
the whole face lights up（脸都亮了）
10米开外，感受到你的气场。
Your presence is felt ten meters away.
your presence（你的气场）
paraphrase: 显白两度 → two shades brighter / lifts you two tones
scenes.speak: Two shades brighter — this is Angola red. After applying, the whole face lights up. Your presence is felt ten meters away.

scenes.title_cn: 信任收尾 + 被夸的价值
scenes.title_en: Trust Close and the Value of Being Praised
scenes.context: 宝贝，不是重要的场合不要穿它，因为会过于隆重。你去开会、出席重要场合、演讲的时候你穿它，没人会觉得你很菜，10米开外就觉得你是个人物。等你需要的时候再买来不及了。人都喜欢被夸，被夸真的能把人托起来。语域：直播教学，信任收尾。
sentences: 不是重要场合，不要穿它，太隆重。
Save it for big occasions — it's too formal otherwise.
too formal otherwise（过于隆重）
你去演讲穿它，没人觉得你很菜。
Wear it to give a talk and nobody sees you as a pushover.
a pushover（很菜）
人都喜欢被夸，被夸能把人托起来。
Everyone loves praise — it can truly lift a person.
lift a person（把人托起来）
scenes.speak: Save it for big occasions — it's too formal otherwise. Wear it to give a talk and nobody sees you as a pushover. Everyone loves praise — it can truly lift a person.

practice: That's just echoing — the wrong example.
Elite stage control catches the emotion.
Two shades brighter — this is Angola red.
Everyone loves praise — it can truly lift a person.
pitfalls: Elite stage control catches the emotion.
Two shades brighter — this is Angola red.
Everyone loves praise — it can truly lift a person.
「把人托起来」用 lift a person。
shifts: 用 stage control（场控）、catch the emotion（接情绪）、echo（接话）
用 two shades brighter（显白两度）、your presence（气场）、lights up（亮起来）
用 a pushover（很菜）、too formal（太隆重）、lift a person（把人托起来）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：公帐→公屏、显灰→显黑、安格拉红、猪肝色、牛血色、10米开外、很菜→不菜、人物、信货在场→货量有限、场空→场控、横托→烘托、突击起来→托起来、被夸人夸人→被夸能托起人等。
